lines.zh: 铁壁一晃，三十二桶水在响。
lines.en: My iron wall sways and thirty-two buckets slosh.

lines.zh: 我每走一步，地面就陷一寸。
lines.en: Each step of mine sinks the ground an inch.

lines.zh: 釜底拖出两道深深的沟。
lines.en: My cauldron base drags two deep furrows.

lines.zh: 里面的液体互相撞着，像潮。
lines.en: The liquid inside collides with itself like surf.

lines.zh: 我迈得很慢，怕溅出半桶。
lines.en: I step slowly, afraid of spilling half a bucket.

lines.zh: 你站在釜里，跟着我的节奏晃。
lines.en: Stand inside me and sway with my rhythm.

lines.zh: 铁箍吱呀作响，我在赶路。
lines.en: My iron hoops creak; I am on the road.

lines.zh: 我的腿短，肚子太大。
lines.en: My legs are short and my belly is vast.

lines.zh: 我踩碎石，石头沉进釜里化了。
lines.en: I crush a stone and it sinks in and dissolves.

lines.zh: 走过村庄，狗全叫起来了。
lines.en: Walking past a village, every dog starts barking.

lines.zh: 我一路留下一串湿脚印。
lines.en: I leave a string of wet footprints behind.

lines.zh: 液体在釜里拐弯，我听见了。
lines.en: The liquid turns a corner inside me; I hear it.

lines.zh: 我往坡上走，水就往我背后涌。
lines.en: Climbing a slope, the water surges to my back.

lines.zh: 别催，我这身铁比牛车还沉。
lines.en: Do not rush me; this iron is heavier than an ox cart.

lines.zh: 我站着不动，液体也在转。
lines.en: I stand still and the liquid keeps turning.

lines.zh: 釜口冒着热气，我不用生火。
lines.en: Steam rises from my rim; I light no fire.

lines.zh: 里面泡着不知谁倒的药渣。
lines.en: Someone's potion dregs soak inside me.

lines.zh: 一只青蛙跳进来，游了两圈。
lines.en: A frog hops in and swims two laps.

lines.zh: 铁壁凉下来，我听见它收缩。
lines.en: The iron cools and I hear it contract.

lines.zh: 我在等下一桶，等得铁都暖了。
lines.en: Waiting for the next bucket, I warm the iron through.

lines.zh: 村民远远看着，把我当成女巫的锅。
lines.en: Villagers watch from afar, taking me for a witch's pot.

lines.zh: 傀儡绕着我走，怕我煮了它主人。
lines.en: A golem walks around me, fearing I will boil its master.

lines.zh: 我闻得到每层液体的味道。
lines.en: I can smell every layer of liquid inside.

lines.zh: 雨水落进釜里，也算我的。
lines.en: Rain falls in, and that counts as mine too.

lines.zh: 我用釜沿磨掉身上的锈。
lines.en: I rub the rust off against my own rim.

lines.zh: 有只鸟在釜边喝水，我没赶它。
lines.en: A bird drinks at my rim; I let it stay.

lines.zh: 装满了，我就懒得动。
lines.en: Filled up, I cannot be bothered to move.

lines.zh: 釜里映着天，我看了很久。
lines.en: The sky reflects inside me, and I watch it a while.

lines.zh: 你探头往里看，看见自己的脸。
lines.en: Lean in and you will see your own face.

lines.zh: 你敲了敲铁壁，声音很闷。
lines.en: You knock the iron wall; the sound is dull.

lines.zh: 你数着釜里的水位，少了一指。
lines.en: You check my level; it dropped a finger's width.

lines.zh: 你想爬进来，先脱鞋。
lines.en: If you mean to climb in, take your boots off.

lines.zh: 你身后那口小锅，装不下我一口。
lines.en: That little pot behind you holds one mouthful of mine.

lines.zh: 你的药水瓶在我面前太小了。
lines.en: Your potion bottle looks tiny next to me.

lines.zh: 你盯着我的铁箍，像在找接缝。
lines.en: You study my hoops as if hunting for a seam.

lines.zh: 你在闻吗，里面是别人的配方。
lines.en: Sniffing, are you? That is someone else's recipe.

lines.zh: 你把手伸向釜口，我晃了一下。
lines.en: You reach for my rim, so I sway once.

lines.zh: 你看我的眼神，像看一口井。
lines.en: You look at me the way one looks down a well.

lines.zh: 你带了桶来，我猜到了。
lines.en: You brought a bucket; I had guessed.

lines.zh: 你退开半步，是怕我泼出来。
lines.en: You step back half a pace, afraid I will spill.

lines.zh: 铁被打凹，里面的液体晃出来。
lines.en: The iron dents and liquid sloshes out.

lines.zh: 你砍出一道口子，我在漏。
lines.en: You cut a gash open and I am leaking.

lines.zh: 我疼，但铁不会喊。
lines.en: I hurt, but iron does not cry out.

lines.zh: 这一下把我的箍震松了。
lines.en: That shock loosened one of my hoops.

lines.zh: 我的液体混进了泥，浪费。
lines.en: My liquid mixed into the mud; what a waste.

lines.zh: 你用镐敲我，像在开矿。
lines.en: You hammer me with a pick, as if mining.

lines.zh: 补丁又裂了，我记下这笔。
lines.en: The patch split again, and I note the debt.

lines.zh: 我一动不动，让你多砍几下。
lines.en: I stand still and let you cut a few more times.

lines.zh: 我的釜底开始渗黑水。
lines.en: Black water starts seeping from my base.

lines.zh: 别打釜口，那里最薄。
lines.en: Do not strike my rim; that is the thinnest part.

lines.zh: 你提着桶，那就是给我的。
lines.en: You are carrying a bucket, so that is for me.

lines.zh: 那瓶药水，倒进来吧。
lines.en: That potion bottle, pour it in.

lines.zh: 我闻到岩浆的味道了。
lines.en: I smell lava on you.

lines.zh: 牛奶也行，我不挑。
lines.en: Milk will do too; I am not picky.

lines.zh: 你手里那点液体，够我润喉。
lines.en: That little bit of liquid would wet my throat.

lines.zh: 倒吧，我釜底还空着一格。
lines.en: Pour it; I have one compartment still empty.

lines.zh: 那桶水晃得我心痒。
lines.en: That bucket sways and makes my iron itch.

lines.zh: 我不吃面包，我只喝东西。
lines.en: I do not eat bread; I only drink.

lines.zh: 你把液体举高，我伸长脖子。
lines.en: Lift the liquid higher and I stretch my neck.

lines.zh: 一桶不够，你还有吗。
lines.en: One bucket is not enough; do you have more?

lines.zh: 撞上我，你的骨头会响。
lines.en: Run into me and your bones will answer.

lines.zh: 我的铁壁不会让路。
lines.en: My iron wall does not give way.

lines.zh: 你被弹开，坐进了泥里。
lines.en: You bounce off and sit down in the mud.

lines.zh: 这一下把我震得洒了几滴。
lines.en: That shock spilled a few drops out of me.

lines.zh: 我太重，撞你等于撞墙。
lines.en: I am so heavy that hitting me is hitting a wall.

lines.zh: 你使劲推，我连一滴都没洒。
lines.en: Push all you like; I do not spill a drop.

lines.zh: 铁箍响了一声，你退了三步。
lines.en: A hoop rings once and you back off three steps.

lines.zh: 我踩到你的脚，抱歉，感觉不到。
lines.en: I stepped on your foot; sorry, I cannot feel it.

lines.zh: 我们撞在一起，你的盾凹了。
lines.en: We collide and your shield dents.

lines.zh: 让开点，我刹不住。
lines.en: Get clear; I cannot brake.

lines.zh: 两口釜靠在一起，会碰出钟声。
lines.en: Two cauldrons leaning together ring like bells.

lines.zh: 我的伴侣比我多装五桶。
lines.en: My mate holds five buckets more than I do.

lines.zh: 我们把液体倒进对方肚里。
lines.en: We pour our liquids into each other.

lines.zh: 两口釜并排走，路会塌。
lines.en: Two cauldrons walking abreast cave the road in.

lines.zh: 我们不用繁殖，只需要焊在一起。
lines.en: We need no breeding, only to be welded together.

lines.zh: 它敲釜沿，我就知道是它。
lines.en: It taps my rim, and I know it is the one.

lines.zh: 我们的铁壁会一起生锈。
lines.en: Our iron walls will rust together.

lines.zh: 空釜相遇时，声音最好听。
lines.en: Two empty cauldrons meeting make the finest sound.

lines.zh: 它装的药，我从不问配方。
lines.en: I never ask what brew it carries.

lines.zh: 别盯着，铁也会害羞。
lines.en: Stop staring; iron can be shy too.

lines.zh: 你把掉落的铁片塞进包里。
lines.en: You stuff the fallen iron scrap into your bag.

lines.zh: 那块铁是我釜沿上崩的。
lines.en: That iron broke off my rim.

lines.zh: 你捡到的液滴还在发烫。
lines.en: The droplet you picked up is still hot.

lines.zh: 别用手接，那是强酸。
lines.en: Do not catch it barehanded; that is strong acid.

lines.zh: 你捡起我漏下的药渣，闻了闻。
lines.en: You pick up my leaked dregs and sniff them.

lines.zh: 掉出来的东西都是别人的配方。
lines.en: Whatever falls out is somebody else's recipe.

lines.zh: 你收好那块铁，它还能补锅。
lines.en: Keep that iron; it can patch a pot.

lines.zh: 你捡走一滴，我就少一滴。
lines.en: Every drop you take is one drop less.

lines.zh: 那些碎渣别丢，能炼。
lines.en: Do not throw those crumbs away; they smelt.

lines.zh: 你弯腰捡，我往下看了一眼。
lines.en: You bend to pick it up and I glance down at you.

lines.zh: 你往我釜里倒脏东西，我记住了。
lines.en: You poured filth into me, and I remember.

lines.zh: 你拿桶接我的液体，那就是偷。
lines.en: Catching my liquid in a bucket is theft.

lines.zh: 你举剑的样子，让我想起清理锅底的人。
lines.en: That raised sword reminds me of the one who scoured my base.

lines.zh: 你站在我必经的路上。
lines.en: You are standing on the path I must take.

lines.zh: 这一带只有你一个会打铁的。
lines.en: You are the only smith in these parts.

lines.zh: 你身上有女巫的味道，我讨厌。
lines.en: You smell of a witch, and I dislike it.

lines.zh: 你砸我的箍，我听见了。
lines.en: You struck my hoop; I heard it.

lines.zh: 你把我当障碍，我就当你是钉子。
lines.en: You treat me as an obstacle, so I treat you as a nail.

lines.zh: 我要碾过去的，就是你。
lines.en: The one I mean to roll over is you.

lines.zh: 你退得太晚，我已经提速。
lines.en: You retreat too late; I am already speeding up.

lines.zh: 你烧我的液体，我闻到了焦味。
lines.en: You burned my liquid; I smell the scorch.

lines.zh: 傀儡不敢拦我，你敢。
lines.en: The golem would not stop me, but you did.

lines.zh: 你手里的桶，我改变主意了。
lines.en: That bucket in your hand changes my mind.

lines.zh: 我滚过去，你就知道了。
lines.en: Let me roll through and you will understand.

lines.zh: 我慢慢转过来，铁在地上刮。
lines.en: I turn slowly, iron scraping the ground.

lines.zh: 我的影子把你整片盖住。
lines.en: My shadow covers the whole of you.

lines.zh: 你在数距离，我在数桶数。
lines.en: You count distance; I count buckets.

lines.zh: 我把身子侧过来，釜口对你。
lines.en: I turn side-on and point my rim at you.

lines.zh: 你往左跑，我的腿先到。
lines.en: Run left and my leg arrives first.

lines.zh: 我晃一下，液体就要泼出来了。
lines.en: One sway and the liquid is ready to spill.

lines.zh: 你举盾，我打算连盾一起压。
lines.en: Raise the shield; I will press it down with you.

lines.zh: 我盯着你的脚，不看你的剑。
lines.en: My eyes are on your feet, not that blade.

lines.zh: 我停了一息，那是蓄力。
lines.en: I pause for a breath; that is me winding up.

lines.zh: 你身后是墙，我看见了。
lines.en: There is a wall behind you, and I saw it.

lines.zh: 我故意漏出一点液体引你靠近。
lines.en: I leak a little on purpose to draw you near.

lines.zh: 我的铁箍在收紧，声音变了。
lines.en: My hoops tighten and the sound changes.

lines.zh: 你喊同伴，我不在乎几个。
lines.en: Call your friends; their number does not matter.

lines.zh: 我再靠近半步，你就没地方躲了。
lines.en: Half a step more and you have nowhere left.

lines.zh: 我一侧身，滚烫的液体泼出去。
lines.en: I tilt and scalding liquid washes out.

lines.zh: 铁沿砸下来，你的盾裂了。
lines.en: My rim comes down and your shield splits.

lines.zh: 我用釜底压你，像压一块石头。
lines.en: I press you down with my base, like a stone.

lines.zh: 你被烫得跳开，鞋底冒烟。
lines.en: The heat makes you leap back, soles smoking.

lines.zh: 这一撞，你的护甲凹进去一块。
lines.en: This blow dents your armor in.

lines.zh: 我把你撞进自己泼的水里。
lines.en: I knock you into the liquid I spilled.

lines.zh: 铁箍刮过你的肩，带走一层皮。
lines.en: A hoop rakes your shoulder and takes skin.

lines.zh: 你砍我，只砍出一道白痕。
lines.en: You cut me and leave a white scratch.

lines.zh: 我用整口釜的重量碾过去。
lines.en: I roll the weight of a full cauldron over you.

lines.zh: 液体灌进你的领口，别喊。
lines.en: Liquid pours down your collar; do not shout.

lines.zh: 你退到墙边，我正好压上。
lines.en: You back to the wall, and I lean in.

lines.zh: 我撞你的膝盖，你跪下了。
lines.en: My rim catches your knee; down you go.

lines.zh: 这一下是替被偷的那桶。
lines.en: This one is for the bucket you stole.

lines.zh: 你身上全是我的配方了。
lines.en: You are wearing my whole recipe now.

lines.zh: 我从地底的炉渣里长出来。
lines.en: I grow up out of slag deep underground.

lines.zh: 有人把整口釜埋在这里。
lines.en: Someone buried a whole cauldron here.

lines.zh: 铁锈落尽，我就睁开了釜口。
lines.en: The rust fell away and my rim opened like an eye.

lines.zh: 第一滴水落进来时，我醒了。
lines.en: The first drop fell in, and I woke.

lines.zh: 村子边上多了一口会走的锅。
lines.en: A walking pot has appeared by the village.

lines.zh: 女巫把废料倒在我身上。
lines.en: The witch poured her waste over me.

lines.zh: 我出生就装满了雨水。
lines.en: I was born already full of rainwater.

lines.zh: 井干了，我从井底爬上来。
lines.en: The well dried, so I climbed out of it.

lines.zh: 矿洞里那口弃釜，就是我。
lines.en: That abandoned cauldron in the mine is me.

lines.zh: 我带着半釜岩浆出土。
lines.en: I surface with half a belly of lava.

lines.zh: 铁匠铺的废料堆成了我。
lines.en: The smithy's scrap heap became me.

lines.zh: 雷雨夜，我在院子里站稳了。
lines.en: On a stormy night I planted myself in the yard.

lines.zh: 我从废液池里站起来，滴着水。
lines.en: I stand up out of the waste pool, dripping.

lines.zh: 这地方缺水，我来得正好。
lines.en: This place lacks water, and I arrived right on time.

lines.zh: 火烤着我的铁，里面的液体沸腾了。
lines.en: Fire heats my iron and the liquid inside boils.

lines.zh: 摔落时我先护釜口，液体全洒了。
lines.en: Falling, I guarded my rim and spilled everything.

lines.zh: 我沉下去，釜里釜外都是水。
lines.en: I sink, and there is water inside and out.

lines.zh: 爆炸掀开我的釜口，配方全飞了。
lines.en: The blast throws my rim open and the recipe flies out.

lines.zh: 箭钉进铁壁，液体从孔里喷出。
lines.en: An arrow pierces the wall and liquid jets from the hole.

lines.zh: 魔法让我釜里的液体自己烧起来。
lines.en: Magic sets the liquid inside me alight.

lines.zh: 我饿，空釜里只剩回音。
lines.en: I am starving; only echoes remain in the empty pot.

lines.zh: 雷击在铁壁上，我成了避雷针。
lines.en: Lightning strikes my wall; I have become a rod.

lines.zh: 坠落时我最后做的是倒空自己。
lines.en: Falling, my last act was to empty myself.
